newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius forex market trades $14 million in April.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius forex market trades $14 million in April.

text.p: Transactions on the Mauritius interbank foreign market reached 286.81 million rupees ($14 million) in April from 152.41 million rupees ($7.5 million) in March, the central bank said on Friday.
The central bank, the Bank of Mauritius, said during April it sold $26.55 million through intervention to commercial banks at rates ranging from 20.11 to 20.60 rupees, from $45 million in March.
"Sales of foreign currencies by the Mauritius Sugar Syndicate (MSS) to commercial banks increased marginally, from 5.23 million dollars in March 1997 to 5.36 million dollars in April 1997," it added.
The central bank said it continued to be the highest provider of foreign currencies with a 58 percent share in April, compared with a 30 percent share for the interbank market and 12 percent for MSS.

Foreign exchange reserves of the central bank rose by 503 million rupees ($24.5 million) to 17.62 billion rupees ($864 million) at the end of April, representing 24.3 weeks of imports. In March, reserves stood at 17.12 billion rupees ($840 million).
